name: dsh-plugin-file-actions
description: Extends the presented-file card menu in the DSH web GUI on macOS, Windows, and Linux: copy relative/absolute path, open the file in detected editors (VS Code, Sublime Text, Rider, ...), and run it in a terminal or open its directory. App resolution reuses the official open-in-app catalog resolver; visibility follows the official open-in-app probe; icons come from the official icon route.
author: cholf5 <cholf5@hotmail.com>
